criteria_verification.notes: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements IdentityProvider with sync currentPrincipal getter backed by _currentPrincipal field, async signIn(), and async signOut() methods. Port interface unchanged.

_performSignIn() checks stored session, attempts _silentRefresh() via FlutterAppAuth.token() first, falls back to _interactiveSignIn() via authorizeAndExchangeCode() only when silent refresh unavailable or fails. PKCE S256 is flutter_appauth default.

Interactive flow uses AuthorizationTokenRequest with _config.clientId, _config.redirectUrl (com.appmilla.studytutor:/oauth2redirect), _config.issuer, and _config.scopes including 'offline_access'. KeycloakConfig enforces correct values.

SignInCancelled and SignInFailed are distinct exception types. _interactiveSignIn() catches FlutterAppAuthPlatformException and uses _isCancelError() to check for CANCELED code, throwing appropriate exception type. Cancel and failure never conflated.
Single-flight guard implemented via _signInInFlight Future field. signIn() checks if Future is in flight and returns existing Future instead of starting new flow. Field cleared when Future completes.

_scheduleProactiveRefresh() schedules Timer to refresh 5 minutes before expiry using response.accessTokenExpirationDateTime. Called after successful token operations. _performBackgroundRefresh() executes refresh and updates cached principal, preventing re-sign-in during idle periods within offline session validity (KC-G3).

Generation-based epoch using _generation counter. signOut() increments _generation, cancels refresh timer, clears principal and store. All refresh operations capture generation at start and check before updating principal, discarding updates if generation changed. SignOut wins refresh race.

_performBackgroundRefresh() has try-catch wrapping token refresh. On exception, clears _currentPrincipal and store if generation unchanged. Never propagates exceptions to callers. Degrades gracefully to sign-in fallback without crashing or hanging.

_performSignIn() checks storedSession for null and expiry via _isExpired(). If absent, unreadable (SecureSessionStore returns null), or expired, skips silent refresh and proceeds to interactive flow. No initialization sets principal at launch, treating absent/unreadable/expired as signed out.

FakeAppAuth implementing FlutterAppAuth and FakeSecureSessionStore implementing SecureSessionStore defined in test file. Tests inject fakes via constructor. No real platform channels, browser, or network calls in tests. Fully hermetic.

All modified files (keycloak_identity_provider.dart, keycloak_identity_provider_test.dart, secure_session_store_test.dart) pass lint checks. Player fixed lint errors using initializing formals in FakeAppAuth constructor.
